quests.desc: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to venture north. And then, go west. And then, take a trip west. And then, go to the west. Following that, open the gateway in the attic. After that, attempt to head south. And then, take a trip south. With that over with, move east. And then, go north. Next, move east. After that, move south. Next, try to travel east. And then, try to move south. Okay, and then, lift the keycard from the floor of the austere studio. That's it!

After that, make an attempt to go to the west. After that, make absolutely sure that the gateway is opened. Having pulled open the gateway, make an attempt to move south. Okay, and then, move south.
